name: Review Year
description: Disconnected year selector: KPIs use selected year, while trend charts retain all three financial years.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("H4sIAAAAAAAA/4uOVjIyMDLUNTIwMlKK1VEAc41AXGM41xjENVGKjQUAflOFPy0AAAA=",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"Financial Year"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"Financial Year", type text}}) in X

name: Statement Layout
description: Statement comparison layout; all amounts derive from supplied statements, no synthetic balancing items.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"Order","Statement","Line Item","Metric"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"Order", Int64.Type},{"Statement", type text},{"Line Item", type text},{"Metric", type text}}) in X

name: Credit Notes
description: Evidence-based SWOT. Selected-year profitability/ratios plus explicitly historical source flags. No automatic approval score or unsupported risk thresholds.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("H4sIAAAAAAAA/4uONtRRUAouKUrNSy/JUIrVUYg20lFQCk9NzM5LLS4GCxjrKCj5FxTkF5WU5mWWVILFTHQUlEIyilITS5RiYwH1+mPoRQAAAA==",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"Order","Topic"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"Order", Int64.Type},{"Topic", type text}}) in X

name: Calculation Register
description: All 25 numbered financial/credit parameters in the supplied credit due diligence PDF; definition caveats and missing evidence are explicit.
mExpression: let R=Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("",BinaryEncoding.Base64),Compression.GZip)), T=Table.FromRows(R,{"No","Category","Parameter","Formula","Metric","Unit","Evidence Status","Interpretation"}), X=Table.TransformColumnTypes(T,{{"No", Int64.Type},{"Category", type text},{"Parameter", type text},{"Formula", type text},{"Metric", type text},{"Unit", type text},{"Evidence Status", type text},{"Interpretation", type text}}) in X
